class.name: HTMLTextAreaElement
class.brief_description: A handle to an HTML multiline text field.
class.description: Returned by queries and [method HTMLLayout.create_element] for [code]<textarea>[/code]. Edit the current value with [member value] and the source text with [member default_value]. A changed value belongs to the current layout. Fields render in [HTMLLayout] and can be edited in [HTMLLabel]. The default size uses [code]rows[/code] and [code]cols[/code]. CSS can override the size, wrapping and [code]resize[/code] behavior. In [HTMLLabel], Enter inserts a newline and Tab moves to the next focusable element. Drag the bottom-right handle to resize a field that allows it.

method.name: get_selection_start
method.description: Returns the selection start, or [code]-1[/code] for an invalid textarea handle.

method.name: get_selection_end
method.description: Returns the selection end, or [code]-1[/code] for an invalid textarea handle.

method.name: set_selection_range
method.description: Sets a multi-line selection using Godot string character indices. Indices snap to grapheme boundaries. Visual line breaks do not change the indices.

members.member: The child text used as the initial value.
The current value with LF line endings. Setting it from script does not emit a user editing signal.
